# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 16 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 16 | **Condition:** moderately preserved

---

**16:1** I thank You, Lord, for You have not thrown my lot in with the community of liars,

**16:2** and You have not assigned me a share in the company of the secretive.

**16:3** Instead You have called me to Your grace and to Your forgiveness [...]

**16:4** and to the wealth of Your mercy for everyone who turns back to You.

**16:5** You did not hand my case to the council of the hidden,

**16:6** and You did not store up truth for those walking the wicked road.

**16:7** I know You have chosen me for [...] and that no one poisoned by wicked speech will wander from Your path.

**16:8** I know that in Your hand every spirit is shaped, and You determined its purpose

**16:9** before You ever created it. How could anyone rewrite Your words?

**16:10** You alone made the righteous one, and from the womb You designed him

**16:11** for the moment of favor -- to be guarded inside Your covenant and to walk in all Your ways,

**16:12** to [...] upon him in the wealth of Your mercy, to open every locked-up pain in his soul

**16:13** to everlasting rescue and endless peace without any lack. You have lifted his dignity

**16:14** above all mortal beings.

**16:15** But the wicked You made for the time of Your fury, and from the womb You marked them out

**16:16** for the day of massacre. They walk a road that leads nowhere good,

**16:17** they have thrown away Your covenant, their very souls recoil from Your truth.

**16:18** They found no joy in anything You commanded, and they chose everything You despise.

**16:19** According to the mysteries of Your knowledge You have [...] all their punishment

**16:20** for Your judgment, to execute justice upon them before everything You have made,

**16:21** so they will stand as a warning sign for all ages to come, and everyone will know Your glory

**16:22** and Your immense power. And what is a mortal that he could grasp any of this?

**16:23** How can a clay pot understand wonders? He has lived in wrongdoing since the womb,

**16:24** and all the way to old age he wallows in guilt. I know

**16:25** that no human being owns righteousness, and no person walks a flawless path.

**16:26** Only the Most High God does what is truly right, and a person's road has no firm footing

**16:27** unless God's own spirit -- the one He shaped for that person -- steadies it, straightening the road for the human race,

**16:28** so that everything He made can witness the force of His strength and the depth of His compassion

**16:29** for everyone He has chosen.

**16:30** As for me, holy fear has gripped me, shaking and trembling have taken over,

**16:31** every bone cries out [...] my heart melts like wax beside a fire,

**16:32** my knees [...] because I remember my own guilt and the unfaithfulness handed down by my ancestors.

**16:33** Wicked people rose against Your covenant, worthless people against Your word.

**16:34** I told myself: My sin has surely cut me off from Your covenant.

**16:35** But the moment I remembered the power of Your hand and the ocean of Your mercy, I got up.

**16:36** I stood, and my spirit braced itself against the attack, because I planted myself on Your faithful love

**16:37** and the ocean of Your mercy, because You wipe away wrongdoing and scrub a mortal clean of guilt by Your justice.

---
*PNEUMA notes: Column 16 is theologically intense, articulating double predestination -- God made the righteous for blessing and the wicked for destruction, both from the womb. The emotional reprise in lines 30-37 shows the psalmist working through fear to faith, over and over.*
